name: Chihara Kaede
source:
Unlike her older sister [url=/c91352]Ren[/url], Kaede is an active girl. She goes to the same school as [url=/c91351]Futaba[/url] and is also her senpai.
Kaede loves cooking and watching the protagonist eat a lot. Day and night she watches cooking videos and recipes and learns from them. Even while camping, she knows how to make things like simple food and girlish sweets just by using the sandwich maker.

Sexual weakness: Being tickled because she is very ticklish.
